description: Goldbridge is an all-in-one, AI-powered financial suite that helps real estate owners optimize their back office operations and their NOI. They intend to offer a credit card, AI- powered operational insights, compliance solutions, among other CFO-suite tools.
tagline: AI-native banking platform for real estate

description: Homeward is an embedded fintech solution that empowers residential brokers to seamlessly offer their customers a variety of competitive financial products to streamline home transactions.

Honey Homes gives homeowners access to a trained and vetted handyperson to help them with all their home maintenance and improvement tasks using a subscription model. Honey Homes allows homeowners to tackle any and all issues related to their home’s upkeep, hassle-free.
tagline: Handyperson subscription for home upkeep and maintenance

description: Indigo helps brokers and broker teams collaborate seamlessly and leverage the latest in AI to level-up their operations and seamlessly navigate new industry regulations.

Latii is a cross-border trade layer allowing buyers of doors in windows in the US to access the Latin American market for the very first time. They offer their buyers high quality materials at very competitive prices from a network of vetted manufacturers, starting with Mexico.
tagline: Better doors and windows through near-shoring

description: Longmark (fka Truehold) is next-generation alternative asset manager. Their core product, Truehold, allows seniors to access their home equity immediately while removing the hassles of maintenance and other property expenses
tagline: (fka Truehold) Sale-leaseback product for America’s seniors

description: Mainstay is a Single Family Rental (SFR) data and transaction platform incubated at OpenDoor. They empower top REITS and other institutional SFR investors with extensive data (e.g., listings, HOA, tax) and transaction (acquisition and disposition) services
tagline: Institutional SFR data and transaction platform

description: Ostrich is a UK-based residential listing service. They connect buyers who can’t find the right property on the open market with owners who are open to selling.

PassiveLogic is disrupting the entire Building Management System tech stack. Their proprietary hardware and artificial intelligence supplements and guides traditional building systems, such as electrical and HVAC, to optimize building operations, energy consumption, and carbon footprint.
tagline: AI-powered hardware and software to automate building management and operations

description: Shepherd is a next-generation construction insurance provider. Their AI-powered technology automates much of the insurance decisioning process, supplementing it with proprietary data from recently-adopted construction tech platforms. This allows them to serve their customers within hours instead of weeks, providing competitive premiums to the best contractors.
tagline: AI-powered underwriting for competitively-priced construction insurance

description: Tempo Works delivers robotics built for the unforgiving demands of industrial and commercial construction. They are starting at the ground level with autonomous concrete grinding, and building toward a scalable robotic ecosystem that will take on the next generation of indoor construction tasks.

ViaBot is automating property management operations, starting with sweeping. Their first robot, RUNO, autonomously sweeps parking lots and garages, empties out trash, and charges itself, while also providing security and facility quality services via its onboard cameras and sensors.
tagline: Autonomous robotics-as-a-service platform for facility management, starting with parking lot and garage sweeping services

description: Welcome Homes allows prospective homebuyers to design and order their home online for a guaranteed price. Welcome Homes leverages the latest in design and automation to bring modern homes and digital-native user experiences to urban infill home construction.
tagline: Design and build your new home online
